help.a.2fa: Profile → "2FA" section → "Enable". A QR code is shown — scan it with your authenticator app and enter the first 6-digit code to confirm. Keep the displayed recovery codes in a safe place — they let you log in even without your phone.
help.a.admin_audit: Settings → Audit log: all security-relevant actions (login, role change, token created/revoked/rotated, webhook created/tested, GDPR delete, user create/delete). Filter by user, date, action type. Retention: permanent.
help.a.admin_automations:
Trigger → action rules. Hourly cron checks them. Examples:
• 7 days in "Contacted" without reply → auto follow-up mail
• 3× mail opened but never clicked → owner notification
• 14 days without status update → status reset

Cooldown per plant prevents double triggering. Settings → Automations.
help.a.admin_backup: Daily 03:00 (systemd timer) — SQLite online backup + integrity check + gzip compression. Retention: 30 daily + 8 weekly (Sundays). Status visible in Settings → Backup. Warning if last backup > 30 h old. Optional off-site sync via rsync (`BACKUP_REMOTE` env).
help.a.admin_gdpr: Settings → GDPR → enter customer email → "Preview" → check what's affected → "Execute". Email history, notes, calls are overwritten with [ANONYMISED]. Plant master data remains (public MaStR), but personal fields are cleared. Audit log keeps 90 days of evidence.
help.a.admin_slas: Maximum idle time per status before a plant is flagged "overdue" and shows up in the dashboard "Pipeline jam" block. Settings → SLAs. Freely configurable per status in days — `0 days` = no warning for this status.
help.a.admin_users: Settings → Users → "+ Add". Username (lowercase, digits, dot/dash/underscore — 2-32 chars), password (min 6), email, role. Roles: **Employee** (default), **Admin** (user management, settings, API), **Viewer** (read-only on called plants). Admin + Viewer are mutually exclusive.
help.a.anfragen_zoho: Public forms at /check and /interesse create a lead in the DB and fire the `lead.created` webhook event. If the MaStR number exists in our DB the inquiry is auto-pinned as a note on the plant. By default the inquiry is also forwarded to Zoho CRM — disabled in Settings → System.
help.a.anlagen_detail:
Click a row to open the modal:
• Master data (MaStR number, address, commissioning, power) — auto-saves on edit
• Map (satellite/road) including "Plants nearby"
• Notes (Markdown, @username mentions)
• Reminders / appointments / calls
• Email history for the plant
• Activity stream
• Economics (repowering yield, additional revenue/year)
help.a.anlagen_filter:
Tab "Plants" → filter bar on top:
• Status (New / Contacted / Appointment …)
• Federal state
• Min/Max kW
• Owner ("Mine" filter shows only those assigned to you)
• Full text (address / MaStR number / operator)

All filters can be combined. The default sort order is set in Profile → Personal preferences.
help.a.api_docs:
• **OpenAPI 3.1 (YAML)** at `/docs/openapi.yaml` — import directly into Postman, Insomnia, Stoplight or Swagger-UI.
• **Markdown reference** in DE/EN/FR: `/docs/API.md`, `/docs/API.en.md`, `/docs/API.fr.md`.
• Over 80 endpoints documented.
help.a.api_first_token: Settings → API → "🔌 Create new API key". Pick a name, scope (`read` / `write` / `full`), optional expiry. The token is shown **only once** — copy it into your password manager now. Lose it and you'll have to create a new one or rotate the old. Format: `msolar_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx`.
help.a.api_idempotency: Send the header `Idempotency-Key: <unique-uuid>` on POST / PUT / PATCH. For an identical key + identical body within 24 h the server returns the stored response (no double insert). Same key + different body → `HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`.
help.a.api_locale:
Header `X-Locale: en` or `X-Locale: fr` on every API call. Fallback is `Accept-Language`. Example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer msolar_…" \
     -H "X-Locale: en" \
     https://mastr-solar.../api/anlagen/999999
→ { "error": "Plant not found", "code": "NOT_FOUND" }
```
help.a.api_rate_limit: Yes. Per token an in-process counter runs. On overrun the server responds `HTTP 429` with `Retry-After: <seconds>` header. The login endpoint is additionally IP-throttled (5 failed attempts/min). Exact budgets in the OpenAPI spec.
help.a.api_rotation: POST on `/api/admin/api-tokens/:id/rotate`. Body optional `{ "grace_minutes": 60 }`. Default = 0 (old token dies instantly). With grace the old stays valid for N minutes so clients can switch gradually. Returns the **new** plaintext token + `old_grace_until`. Audit log entry automatic.
help.a.api_scopes:
**read** — only GET / HEAD / OPTIONS. Pure reporting.
**write** — read + POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE on plants, customers, reminders, notes. Ideal for Zapier, n8n, your own bots.
**full** — like admin: additionally `/api/admin/*` and `/api/users/*`. Only for highly trusted integrations.

Scope is fixed on creation and cannot be changed.
help.a.api_versioning: `/api/v1/<resource>` is a transparent alias for `/api/<resource>`. Future breaking changes will appear under `/api/v2/…` and the v1 path stays stable until deprecation. Currently only v1 is available.
help.a.auto_assign: Auto-assign: whoever first actively works on a customer's plant (changes status, writes a note, logs a call) automatically becomes owner of all that customer's plants. Prevents orphaning and double-work. Can be disabled in Settings (admin).
help.a.campaigns_ab: You pick two templates and set "Split B (%)", e.g. 50. Recipients are randomly split — 50 % get template A, 50 % template B. In Reporting you see open and reply rate per variant. Recommendation: at least 200 recipients, otherwise not statistically valid.
help.a.campaigns_create: Tab "Campaigns" → "New campaign". Set filters (federal state, kW range, "only not contacted"), pick a template, optional A/B split %, then "Create (draft)". In draft you can preview example recipients. "Start" begins delivery with hourly drip + cooldown.
help.a.change_language: Profile → Personal preferences → "Language / Locale" dropdown. Pick German / English / French and click "Save". The page reloads automatically in the new language — all server error messages are now localized too.
help.a.i18n_legally_binding: Imprint and privacy policy are legally binding in their German version (marked at the top of each page as a yellow box). EN/FR translations are for information only. T&Cs / contracts with German consumers are governed by mandatory German consumer protection law.
help.a.i18n_overview: German (master), English, French. 1500+ UI keys in sync. Frontend switches instantly; backend responds localized from the next call (`X-Locale` header). DB always persists in German — translation happens in the display layer.
help.a.inbox_smtp_imap: Profile → SMTP/IMAP settings. Enter your email + password → auto-detect recognises 12 providers (IONOS, Gmail, Office365, Mailbox.org …) and pre-fills host/port. Test button verifies the connection. For Gmail: app password instead of account password. For Office365: optionally use "Advanced" mode for manual server data.
help.a.inbox_tracking_pixel: A single 1×1 image measures whether the email was opened. This shows up as open-rate in your campaigns. Only time and frequency are recorded — no devices or locations. For cold outreach, GDPR requires the recipient to have an unsubscribe link in the footer.
help.a.kalender_termin: From within any plant: click "📅 New appointment" in the detail modal. Title, start, end, optional description — save. The appointment appears immediately in the Calendar tab and can be downloaded as an .ics file.
help.a.kanban_drag: Tab "Kanban" → columns = status values. Drag plant cards between columns — the status is saved instantly and recorded in the activity log. Filter bar on top for federal state / owner / min kW so the board doesn't get cluttered.
help.a.kunden_aggregation:
A plant has exactly one operator (= customer). A customer often has many plants.

"Plants" tab = per-PV-plant view.
"Customers" tab = aggregated view per operator: number of plants, total kWp. Notes and reminders you create at customer level are visible on every one of their plants.
help.a.login: With username + password. If 2FA is enabled, also enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Aegis). After 5 failed attempts your IP is blocked for one minute — wait briefly and retry.
help.a.map_marker_color: Profile → "Map marker colour by": **Status** (default, green = closed, red = spam), **Lead score** (heatmap blue→red), or **Owner** (user colour). Plants without coordinates don't appear — in the detail view you can trigger Nominatim geocoding via "Determine coordinates".
help.a.notes_mention: Write `@username` or `@firstname` directly in the note — the colleague gets an instant in-app notification (bell) plus email/Telegram if enabled. In your profile history you can filter "📣 Outgoing mentions only" to see whom you mentioned, or "📥 Where I was mentioned" for incoming.
help.a.notifications: Profile → Notifications. For each channel (in-app / email / Telegram) and type (mention / DM / assignment / reminder) toggle on or off. In-app is always on. Email needs SMTP configured; Telegram needs the Telegram login (Profile section "Telegram"). Quiet hours: Profile → Personal preferences.
help.a.onboarding:
1) Fill in your profile (name, avatar colour, display name — that's how others see you).
2) Email setup: SMTP + IMAP under Profile → SMTP settings. Auto-detect recognises 12 providers (IONOS, Gmail, Office365 …) automatically.
3) Enable 2FA.
4) On the dashboard check "Pipeline jam" — that's where things are waiting on you.
help.a.profile_export: Currently the list is searchable and paginated (50 per block). CSV export is on the roadmap (`/api/me/activity.csv`). Workaround: poll via API with your personal token `/api/me/activity?limit=200&offset=…` and stitch into Excel.
help.a.profile_filter_mentions: In the history set the Kind dropdown to "📣 Outgoing mentions only". Each entry shows the mentioned user (yellow), the plant, the text, and the timestamp. The reverse case ("where someone mentioned ME") = dropdown on "📥 Where I was mentioned".
help.a.profile_history: Profile → My activity history. By default all actions are combined (your status changes, notes, mails, appointments + every place you @-mentioned somebody). Filters on the right: kind (all / mentions only / own actions), type (status change, note, email …), search, date range.
help.a.ts_backup_warning: Admin: SSH → `systemctl status mastr-solar-backup`. Common causes: backup directory full, BACKUP_REMOTE unreachable, sqlite3 lock. Manual test: `bash /opt/mastr-solar/scripts/backup-db.sh`. Status file `/opt/mastr-solar/data/.backup-status.json` contains the exact error.
help.a.ts_import_running: First import: 2-4 h (XML download ~2 GB, ~4 M plants). Incremental: < 10 min. Status visible in Settings → Data status. If still "running" after 6 h: admin → SSH → `systemctl status mastr-solar-import`. The lock file at `/opt/mastr-solar/.import.lock` can be removed manually if the process is actually dead.
help.a.ts_mail_not_sent:
Common causes:
1) Test mode is active (Settings → System) — all mail goes to the test address instead of the recipient.
2) SMTP not configured (Profile → SMTP settings).
3) For IONOS/Gmail: sender email must equal the login email (set automatically).
4) Mail in outbox state: wait briefly, cron checks every 5 min.
help.a.ts_password_lost: Currently no self-service reset (roadmap). An admin sets a new password for you in Settings → Users → Edit. If you are the only admin: SSH to the VPS, briefly start the server with `ADMIN_USER=admin ADMIN_PASS=newpw bun server.ts` — the bootstrap path re-sets the password.
help.a.ts_password_lost_done:
On the login screen click "Forgot password?" at the bottom → enter your email → we send a reset link (valid 60 minutes) to your inbox. Follow the link, set a new password. On reset ALL existing sessions are invalidated — you'll have to log in again everywhere.

If SMTP is not configured no email is sent — then an admin needs to set a new password for you manually.
help.a.webhooks_intro: Push notifications for external systems: instead of having your server poll, mastr-solar calls your URL immediately when an event occurs. Available events: `lead.created`, `anfrage.received`, `anlage.status_changed`, `anlage.owner_changed`, `mention.created`, `termin.created`, `reminder.due`.
help.a.webhooks_retry: 3 attempts total: initial + 2 retries with backoff 15 s and 60 s. Per-attempt timeout = 10 s. Status 2xx = success; anything else triggers retry. All attempts are logged in `webhook_deliveries` — visible in Settings → Webhooks → click the webhook → "Recent deliveries".

tour.step.1.body: Your acquisition tool for PV plant repowering. ~41,000 German plants, multi-user, with mail tracking, AI call summary, bulk campaigns and lead scoring. The tour takes 90 seconds — skip anytime.
tour.step.1.title: 👋 Welcome to Solar DB
tour.step.10.body: Pick filter → template → drip settings (e.g. 50 mails/day, 5 min apart). Optional: A/B test with second template, auto-winner after 24h and 30 mails per variant. Sending runs every 5 min in the background.
tour.step.10.title: 📨 Bulk campaigns with A/B test
tour.step.11.body: Map shows all geocoded plants, markers color-coded by status, sized by capacity. Reporting tab gives you KPIs, funnel and per-user performance over 7/30/90 days.
tour.step.11.title: 🗺️ Map & 📊 reporting
tour.step.12.body: In the plant detail top right: 📄 icon generates a repowering offer with plant-specific extra-yield calculation (to print/save as PDF). 🛡️ icon delivers the GDPR data export (Art. 15) as a JSON download.
tour.step.12.title: 📄 PDF offer & 🛡️ GDPR
tour.step.13.body: Optional: enable 2FA with TOTP app in settings (recommended for admin). CSV export is admin-only. Audit log records all security-relevant actions.
tour.step.13.title: 🔐 Security
tour.step.14.body: • ESC closes any modal • @-mention in notes pings colleagues • Drag & drop in Kanban changes status • Tracking pixel works only on HTML mails • Lead score recomputes every 30 min • Backup runs daily at 03:00. Good luck!
tour.step.14.title: ✨ Quick tips
tour.step.15.body: In your profile you'll find your complete activity history — all your actions plus every place you @-mentioned someone or were mentioned. Full-text search, date filter, CSV export.
tour.step.15.title: 📋 Your personal history
tour.step.16.body: Connect external systems? In Settings → API you create API tokens (read/write/full scopes) and webhooks for 7 event types (lead.created, anlage.status_changed …). With HMAC signature, IP whitelist, and an optional sandbox mode for testing.
tour.step.16.title: 🔌 API + webhooks
tour.step.17.body: The full UI is available in German, English, and French — including server error messages, mail signatures, salutations (Herr/Mr/M.), and date formats. Switch language in your profile.
tour.step.17.title: 🌐 Multilingual (DE/EN/FR)
tour.step.2.body: ⭐ Today (top-score leads), Plants, Kanban, 🗺️ Map, Calendar, 📨 Inbox (email replies), Campaigns, 📊 Reporting and Settings. Click and you'll see immediately what happens.
tour.step.2.title: 🧭 9 main areas
tour.step.3.body: Plant count, total capacity in MW/GW, new leads and already contacted. Live from the DB, no caching.
tour.step.3.title: 📊 At a glance
tour.step.4.body: State, status, owner, capacity. Search covers name, operator, city and contact data — results appear instantly. Now also sortable by lead score.
tour.step.4.title: 🔍 Filter & search
tour.step.5.body: @-mentions, direct messages, plant assignments, new email replies. Optionally also via email and Telegram (configurable in settings).
tour.step.5.title: 🔔 Notifications
tour.step.6.body: Floating button for direct messages with colleagues. ESC closes the panel — like all other modals.
tour.step.6.title: 💬 Team chat (bottom right)
tour.step.7.body: Each plant automatically gets a score (0–200) from email opens, clicks, replies, calls, sentiment and status. The ⭐ Today tab shows you the top 30 daily — those are the leads to call first.
tour.step.7.title: ⭐ Lead scoring & "Today" tab
tour.step.8.body: Every sent mail contains an invisible tracking pixel + click wrapping. Replies are auto-collected via IMAP and matched to the plant. Important: in Settings → IMAP enter your mailbox credentials once + enable "Auto-polling".
tour.step.8.title: 📨 Email tracking & inbox
tour.step.9.body: Clicking 📞 next to a phone number opens your native phone. Stopwatch runs in the modal, write a note, save. The AI summarizes, suggests next steps and status (set Anthropic key in Settings → AI assistant).
tour.step.9.title: 📞 Telephony + AI summary
